def Npos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def Rpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']<40:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def Bpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<40:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def st(): return (Npos(current_frame),Rpos(current_frame),Bpos(current_frame))

BLU = {'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}

spiral=['RIGHT','DOWN','LEFT','LEFT','UP','UP','RIGHT','RIGHT']

        if win(): break
print("final",st())
